purpose: The cases the native primitive gallery must be rendered, inspected, and approved at. Nothing in CI renders, lays out, or captures these cases; this file is the checklist that evidence has to cover, not the evidence.
determinism: Synthetic resource-backed strings only; no clock, network data, animation frame, font fallback, or OS-specific capture is accepted.

notInGallery.reason: The gallery is one fixed column with no width-driven layout, no horizontally scrolling table, and no ordered map or chart data list, so no case can capture these until a later #266 change adds them.

treeExpectations: a named Main landmark in the control view
every gallery automation id in the control view with a name
the state banner named with its tone word and title
polite and assertive live-region text elements
each table row exposed as a named group
the toolbar exposed as a ToolBar
no decorative glyph or outline in the control view
